chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abdul Kareem ibn Amr, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
One cannot copulate with the girl until there come to her nine years or ten years.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum age for a girl to be married and consummated according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the minimum age for consummation of marriage for a female, stating that she must reach either nine or ten years of age before intercourse is permissible. It serves as a primary legal ruling in Shia jurisprudence regarding the age of puberty and marital rights, often cited in discussions on 'bulugh' (puberty) versus 'rushd' (maturity). The narration highlights the flexibility in the age range, allowing for nine or ten years depending on the scholar's interpretation of the physical signs of maturity.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abdul Kareem Bin Amro, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
One cannot copulate with the girl until there come to her nine years or ten years’.
